personal.name: Amr Abdallah
personal.title: Solutions Architect | Applied AI Engineer | Senior Full-Stack Engineer
personal.summary: Senior Software Engineering Lead with 10+ years of hands-on engineering. I design and build systems that connect hardware, data, and people: real-time IoT telemetry on Azure, company-wide web applications behind a single authentication gateway, and a Copilot Studio agent that answers thousands of questions a month over enterprise quality and supply-chain data. I lead a team of engineers, own delivery from requirements and architecture through automated deployment, and still write production code every week.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineering Lead
experience.summary: Leading software engineering for a venture-backed clean-energy company: cloud architecture on Azure, company-wide web applications, real-time IoT, and AI agents.
bullets: Engineered a real-time IoT data pipeline: hardware boards publish MQTT messages to Azure Web Apps that decode and normalize multi-sensor readings onto shared timestamps, feeding Kusto (Grafana dashboards), MongoDB, and a live client that charts telemetry and starts/stops fans and motors.

Built the company's analytics platform, turning operational logs and test-technician experiment data into the KPIs behind company decisions and reports, with Docker-hosted Redis caching large queries.
Architected a company-wide MERN suite behind one authentication gateway, spanning QMS, SCM, HR, assets, quality data, fabrication, and ticketing, saving thousands of hours.

Delivered a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent running on Claude, used company-wide in Teams (thousands of questions a month), that answers QMS, NCR, ECR, purchasing, and KPI questions in seconds and flags recurring issues, bottlenecks, and failing equipment.
Implemented the secured, read-only Azure API behind the agent (Entra ID OAuth), exposing curated MongoDB aggregation views as LLM tools, so the model never writes raw database queries.
Developed a C# WinForms data logger and controller that charts live voltage, current, temperature, and flow and actuates hardware; now migrating it to React and .NET Core.
Set up CI/CD with Jenkins and GitHub webhooks for all web apps, Terraform provisioning, and a self-hosted Gitea server on the internal network; own unit, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Lead the engineering team, owning hiring, performance reviews, and delivery, and coordinate with leadership and the testing, fabrication, hardware, firmware, HR, and finance teams.
Created the data-cleaning pipeline feeding Monolith AI's platform, whose predictive models for experiments and chemical reactions replaced many physical tests and cut costs by 32%.

bullets: Contributed to SHORE, built with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL on AWS (API Gateway, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, S3, IAM, CloudTrail).
Directed cross-functional teams across the full project lifecycle, maintained the backlog, and prioritized work across simultaneous development and deployment projects.
Set up Docker-based development environments and web deployments.

Supervise co-op students.

Developed a client-facing progressive web app over WebSocket, plus Node.js microservices for file parsing, socket bridging, and automation.
